settings.heading: Shipping, returns and everything between.
settings.text: Search a topic, or pick shipping, products, subscriptions or membership.

settings.question: How fast do orders leave?
settings.answer: Orders are packed within one to three business days. A tracking email follows, though it can take up to 48 hours to show movement.

settings.question: What does standard shipping cost?
settings.answer: $5.95, and free once your basket reaches $40. We ship to all fifty states and to 180 countries.

settings.question: Who pays duties and taxes abroad?
settings.answer: Some destinations collect them at checkout; in others the carrier bills you on delivery. The checkout page tells you which applies.

settings.question: Can you send to a PO box?
settings.answer: Yes, with standard shipping. Express options need a street address.

settings.question: Which skin types are your products for?
settings.answer: Filter the shop by skin type or concern to see what suits dry, oily, combination, sensitive or blemish-prone skin.

settings.question: Can I engrave a scent bottle?
settings.answer: Yes. Use the engrave link on the fragrance page to add up to a few letters before you check out.

settings.question: How do I change a subscription?
settings.answer: Sign in and open manage subscriptions to skip, move or end a delivery.

settings.heading: Be first to know about the next drop
settings.message: New scents, balm flavours and member-only sale days, no more than one note a week.
